The '''IA/4 Fusial Thrust Reactor''' was an [[Engine/Legends|engine]] produced by [[Telgorn Corporation/Legends|Telgorn Corporation]]. They were installed on Telgorn's [[Gamma-class assault shuttle/Legends|''Gamma''-class assault shuttles]]; each [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] featured a bank of seven engines.
